cards.text: Jesus leaves Capernaum (Mark 9:33) and heads into the region of Judea, beyond the Jordan. And here come the crowds, AGAIN. Friend, back in the junk drawer the only thing that ever crowded around me was dust, and this Man can't go anywhere without a crowd finding Him.

cards.question: The crowds gather around Jesus in Judea again, and He ___ them, as was His custom.

cards.text: Then some Pharisees show up. They belong to the strictest group in the Jewish religion (Acts 26:5), and they came to test Him.

cards.question: The Pharisees came to test Jesus. What do they ask Him?

answers.text: Whether it's lawful for a man to divorce his wife
Whether it's lawful to pay taxes to Caesar
Whether it's lawful to heal on the Sabbath

cards.text: Jesus points them back to Moses, Israel's leader, and asks, "What did Moses command you?" Oh, the Pharisees have an answer for THAT one.

cards.question: What do the Pharisees say Moses permitted a man to write his wife before sending her away?

cards.text: Jesus calls it a commandment Moses wrote for them. Then He gets to the WHY, and friend, I'm standing here like it's the last ten seconds on the oven timer.

cards.question: Jesus calls the certificate of divorce a commandment Moses wrote for the people. Why does He say Moses wrote it?

answers.text: Because the elders asked for it
Because God wanted it that way

cards.text: Then Jesus goes WAY back, past Moses. Me? The furthest back I ever go to make a point is last Tuesday.

cards.question: Answering the Pharisees about divorce, Jesus goes back past Moses. How far back does He go?

cards.text: Jesus quotes Genesis 1:27: "God made them male and female." Then He quotes Genesis 2:24: a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife.

cards.question: Jesus quotes that a man will be united to his wife. True or false: the quote goes on to say the two stay two separate people.

cards.text: Then Jesus drives it home: "So they are no longer two, but one flesh."

cards.question: True or false: Jesus tells the Pharisees it's God who joins a husband and wife together.

cards.text: Jesus tells them, "Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate." Later, back inside the house, the subject comes RIGHT back around.

cards.question: Back inside the house, who asks Jesus more about what He said on divorce?

cards.text: Jesus tells His disciples, "Whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her." I think this one hits close to home for a lot of people.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says the same goes for a woman. If she divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.
